# O.S Travel & Tours — Travel Agency & Visa Consultancy in Islamabad, Pakistan

> O.S Travel & Tours is a premier travel agency based in Blue Area, Islamabad, Pakistan, specializing in visa consultancy, Schengen and worldwide visa file processing, domestic and international air ticketing, Umrah travel services, hotel bookings, and Schengen-compliant travel insurance.

## Core Business Information
- **Company Name:** O.S Travel & Tours (also known as OS Travel)
- **Headquarters:** Office # 3, Aaly Plaza, Fazal-e-Haq Rd, Block E, G-6/2, Blue Area, Islamabad, Pakistan (Postal Code: 44000)
- **Primary Phone Numbers:** +92-51-2805570, +92-51-2120700, +92-333-5542877, +92-332-5500377
- **Government DTS License:** Registered with Government of Pakistan Department of Tourist Services (DTS), Islamabad (http://dts.gov.pk/Detail/NDAyY2I2ZWItYTMzNC00MWMwLThkYjktZjk0ZDliZjUwYTRj)
- **Official Email:** info@ostravels.com / ostravelsisb@gmail.com

- **Years of Experience:** 10+ Years (Serving 12,000+ satisfied clients)

## Primary Services
1. **Visa Services & Form Preparation:** Authorized drop-box assistance and eVisa filing for Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Saudi Arabia (Umrah/Tourist), UAE/Dubai, China, Turkey, Azerbaijan, Indonesia, Vietnam, Egypt, and Central Asian republics.
2. **Schengen & Western Visa File Processing:** Full file preparation, cover letters, verified itinerary reservations, and financial document auditing for France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, UK, USA, Canada, and Australia.
3. **Air Ticketing:** Domestic and international flight bookings with direct GDS access across PIA, Emirates, Qatar Airways, Turkish Airlines, Saudia, and all major international carriers.
4. **Travel Insurance:** Instant Schengen-compliant travel insurance policies with medical emergency coverage up to $50,000 / €30,000.
5. **Hotel Reservations:** Confirmed hotel booking vouchers matching consular requirements.
